Dimaag jo bhi soch sakta hai aur jismein vishwas kar sakta hai, use haasil kar sakta hai.
Discipline goals aur accomplishment ke beech ki bridge hai.
"Perfection nahi, par excellence pakad sakte."
Asli bano.
"Disappointment success ka part hai."
"Progress ki habit banao."
Dots aage dekh ke connect nahi—peeche dekh ke connect.
Character destiny banata.
Tumhari choices future shape karti.
Jo bhi karo, shiddat se karo.
Tumhara samay seemit hai, ise kisi aur ki zindagi jeene mein barbad mat karo.
